notes:
Account summary: mid-market ecommerce company handling payments and returns for multiple marketplace sellers. Primary need is reliable agent assist + automated tool-calling to backend systems (create/update tickets, initiate refunds, escalate to on-call) so agents can resolve flows without context switching.

POC scope: 1) Agent assist with ticket summarization + suggested actions (create/update Zendesk tickets) 2) Tool-calling integration: Zendesk, internal case API (POST /cases), Stripe refunds (POST /refunds), PagerDuty escalation (trigger event) 3) Reliability under spikes: simulate traffic bursts up to 300 requests/sec for 10m windows, measure p95/p99 latency and error budget.

Technical requirements / notes from discovery call:
- Must support function/tool calling semantics with idempotency tokens and transparent audit trail for each external call.
- Webhooks and outbound calls must be signed (HMAC) and routed through customer VPC NAT.
- Data residency: primary EU and NA regions; log payloads masked for PCI-sensitive fields.
- Retention controls: audit logs retained 12 months, ability to redact PII on request.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, and retry counts. Need tracing back from generated text to the exact tool-call payload.
- Model preferences: open models ok if performance matches; interested in Redwood's verified profiles + quantization recommendations to hit cost targets.

Business constraints / quotes: "We need reliable refunds automation — too many manual steps today, agents escalate to finance which is slow. If automation reduces refunds MTTR by 40% we can redeploy staff."

POC plan & timeline:
- Week 0: contract + security NDA signed (done)
- Week 1: infra onboarding (VPC peering + API keys)
- Week 2: integration tests to Zendesk + Stripe sandbox, basic summarization model
- Week 3: 72-hour spike test on Dedicated pool (simulate peak), run observability checks
- Week 4: security questionnaire review, patch idempotency failures, finalize SOW

Open questions for Redwood:
- How will function-calling retries be surfaced in the audit logs? Need mapping to original user message.
- Can Dedicated pool autoscale for 10m burst windows without manual intervention?
- Example webhook signing & rotation cadence for long-lived integrations.
